name: pivax-hacker-replicant
description: AI tutor/copilot chat panel for a PiVAX (VAX 8600 / OpenVMS 7.3) replica -- knows VAX/VMS, DCL, and the "Cuckoo's Egg" history, and can optionally operate the machine's console. LLM-agnostic: works with any OpenAI-compatible backend (Ollama locally by default, or any hosted provider).
